# Reconcile Changes

The Reconcile feature processes merged pull requests and direct commits in a timestamp order to update the compilation state. It ensures that each change is handled precisely once, maintaining an accurate, up-to-date compilation status.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.reconcile`
